What is a Client Management System?

A client management system is a software application designed to help businesses manage their client relationships and interactions. For private investigators, a client management system can help track client information, case files, and communication history. It can also automate tasks such as invoicing, reporting, and reminders, freeing up more time to focus on investigations.

With a client management system, you can:

  • Store and manage client contact information and case files
  • Track communication history and interactions with clients
  • Automate tasks such as invoicing and reporting
  • Set reminders and notifications for upcoming events and deadlines
